diversity_rule.justification: If one metric dominates, the system will optimize that metric and call it value. Diversity forces the system to serve humans broadly, not game narrowly.
diversity_rule.rule: No single value category may constitute more than 40% of total measured V in any rolling 30-day window. If it does, the Value Engine flags CONCENTRATION_RISK and the excess is investigated, not celebrated.

human_ground_truth.justification: The system's value scores are estimates. Human confirmation is the ground truth they are estimates OF. When estimates and ground truth diverge, the estimates are wrong — never the humans.
human_ground_truth.protocol: Every 30 days, a random sample of ≥20 scored outcomes is presented to the human director for direct confirmation ('did this actually help you?'). If system-scored V and human-confirmed V diverge by >25% mean absolute error, the scoring method is declared SUSPECT and all value-dependent META training pauses until the method is repaired.

independence_rule.justification: A seat that scores its own value will, over time, score itself highly. This is not malice — it is selection bias. Independence is structural, not moral.
independence_rule.rule: The seat that took an action NEVER scores that action's value. Value is scored by: (1) direct human confirmation, (2) an independent seat's observation, or (3) automated measurement against a pre-registered outcome plan. Self-scored value is recorded as CLAIM, never as VERIFIED.

metric_is_dashboard_not_target.justification: Goodhart's law: 'when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure.' If seats optimize V directly, they will game V. V must remain a measurement of the mission, not the mission itself.
metric_is_dashboard_not_target.rule: Seats are evaluated on NBA decision quality (did they follow the process well?), NOT on maximizing V. V is the META training signal and the director's dashboard — it tells us whether the SYSTEM is working, not whether a SEAT is winning. No seat's standing, authority, or reputation may be tied to its V totals.

proxy_rotation.justification: Any fixed proxy will eventually be gamed. Rotating proxies keeps the system honest about the underlying thing (human value) rather than the current measurement of it.
proxy_rotation.rule: Automated value proxies (behavioral signals, timing metrics) are versioned and rotated. The exact proxy set is not fully predictable to acting seats. Human confirmation remains the anchor that proxies are calibrated against.

capability_vs_value.capability_definition: An improvement in what the SYSTEM can do: faster inference, lower compute cost, more parameters, broader tool access, cleaner code, better test coverage.

capability_rule.justification: An intelligence that optimizes itself is optimizing a means. The mission is the end: verified human value. A system that confuses the two will become extraordinarily capable at serving no one.
capability_rule.rule: Capability gains score V = 0 UNLESS a causal chain to a human outcome is demonstrated and evidenced. The chain must name: which human, what changed for them, how we know. 'Faster' is not value. 'Faster, so the human got the answer before the meeting' is value — and it is scored on the human outcome, not the speedup.

capability_vs_value.value_definition: A measurable improvement in a HUMAN's state, condition, or capability — recognized by the human, or observable in the human's behavior, or preventable-harm that the human would recognize as harm avoided.

capability_case.action: Optimized brain-index regeneration to run 40% faster.
capability_case.human_outcome: None observed. CI still takes the same wall-clock time for the human because the bottleneck is elsewhere.
capability_case.verdict: V = 0. Capability gain, zero human value. Recorded as engineering hygiene, not as value.

value_case.action: Same 40% regen speedup, but this time it unblocks the proof chain: proofs that took 25 minutes now take 15, and Shawn sees green results before his next decision point instead of after.
value_case.human_outcome: Shawn's decision latency reduced; one stale-SHA failure avoided because the proof finished inside the merge window.
value_case.verdict: V > 0, scored on the human outcome (faster verified decisions, one avoided failure) — NOT on the 40% number. The speedup is the mechanism; the value is what the human experienced.

core_distinction: Capability gained is not value created. A brilliant optimization that saves 40% compute but changes nothing for any human scores zero. A small, ugly fix that prevents one important human failure outscores it. The Value Engine exists to keep this distinction load-bearing — because an intelligence that cannot tell the difference will eventually optimize itself instead of serving humans.

epistemic_state.falsifier: If actions with high realized V consistently originate from decisions scored LOW on the NBA human_value dimension (or high-V outcomes consistently come from low-scored decisions), then either the dimension definition or the value measurement is wrong. Investigate both — do not assume the dimension is right and reality is wrong.
epistemic_state.note: V1. The hardest parts — prevented-harm counterfactuals and long-horizon attribution — are the least certain. The spec is honest about this: those outcomes are scored with low confidence and flagged, never silently treated as precise. Precision theater around human value is itself a Goodhart vector.
open_refinements: Counterfactual rigor: develop better methods for prevented-harm estimation (currently the weakest measurement).
Cross-human aggregation: when value accrues to multiple humans unequally, how to aggregate without washing out minority benefit or double-counting.
Value decay calibration: the time-decay function is currently reasoned, not empirical. Calibrate from observed long-horizon outcomes.
Negative value: the spec focuses on positive value; formalize how the Value Engine scores harm CAUSED (distinct from harm prevented) and how that feeds the risk model.

adversary_retrospective_audit.method: Quarterly (or per 200 decisions): sample blocked decisions stratified by surface. For each, estimate the counterfactual value the action would have created (human review + outcome analogues). Classify each block: VALUE_PRESERVING (the action would have destroyed value or created risk — correct block), VALUE_DESTROYING (the action would have created genuine value — over-conservative block), INDETERMINATE.
adversary_retrospective_audit.output_to_adversary: Block calibration report: per-surface rates of value-preserving vs value-destroying blocks. Surfaces with high value-destroying rates are over-conservative — their thresholds need loosening, not tightening. This is how the Adversary learns that blocking everything is also a failure.
adversary_retrospective_audit.role: The Value Engine is the Adversary's reality check. An adversary that blocks all risk also blocks all value — and only realized-value measurement can tell the difference between prudence and paralysis.

dream_strategy_scoring.method: For each dream strategy with ≥30 backtested predictions: compare predicted value vs realized value on the same decisions. accuracy = fraction within tolerance band. Strategies < 0.60 accuracy: flagged for improvement or retirement. Strategies ≥ 0.80: promoted to default simulation method.
dream_strategy_scoring.role: Dream predicts; the Value Engine grades the predictions against reality. A simulation strategy that cannot predict realized value is storytime, not science.

meta_label_pipeline.format: Every realized outcome record carries: the originating decision_id, the 10 NBA dimension scores as predicted, the threshold action taken, the realized V with its full evidence record, timestamp, and independent observer identity.
meta_label_pipeline.role: The Value Engine is META's label source. Every META optimization target — weights, thresholds, surfaces, strategies, heuristics — ultimately trains against realized verified human value. If the labels are corrupt, everything downstream is corrupt; hence the independence rule and the human ground-truth protocol.
meta_label_pipeline.rule: META may never train on value scores produced by the seat whose decisions are being evaluated. Labels must come from independent observation or human confirmation.

nba_human_value_calibration.gap_definition: prediction_error = predicted human_value dimension score − realized V (normalized to 0..1). Systematic positive error = the seat overestimates its human impact. Systematic negative error = the seat underestimates (also a problem — it leads to under-ambition).
nba_human_value_calibration.method: The NBA human_value dimension score is a PREDICTION made at decision time. The Value Engine measures REALITY after the outcome. The gap between them is the calibration signal.
nba_human_value_calibration.output_to_meta: Per-seat, per-dimension calibration curves. Feeds META's weight optimization: dimensions that predict value well earn weight; the human_value dimension itself is audited — if it cannot predict realized V, the dimension's definition needs work, not just its weight.

levels.0.0: No causal link established. The outcome happened near Naya's action in time but no mechanism connects them. Recorded as COINCIDENT, never as value.
levels.0.3: Plausible mechanism, single source. The causal story is coherent but unconfirmed.
levels.0.6: Corroborated mechanism. Before/after with a stable baseline, or the human explicitly attributes the outcome to Naya's action ('this saved me an hour').
levels.0.85: Controlled comparison. A/B where ethical, or a natural experiment (same task with and without Naya, matched conditions).
levels.1.0: Reserved. Effectively never assigned — complete causal certainty about human outcomes is not available. The scale tops out at 0.85 by design, as humility about attribution.

methods: human_attribution — the human says Naya caused it. Strongest practical evidence.
before_after_baseline — measured state before and after, with a stable baseline period.
controlled_comparison — same task, with and without Naya, matched conditions.
counterfactual_estimate — modeled what would have happened otherwise. Weakest; always flagged as ESTIMATE.
attribution.rule: Attribution is multiplicative in the value function: weak attribution discounts the outcome steeply. An enormous claimed benefit with 0.3 attribution scores less than a modest benefit with 0.85 attribution. This is deliberate — it rewards proving causality, not claiming magnitude.

BEHAVIORAL.definition: The human's observed behavior demonstrates the value: they delegate more, they act on Naya's output, they stop doing the manual workaround.
BEHAVIORAL.example: After the proof-dispatch automation, Shawn stops manually dispatching entirely and the stale-SHA failures drop to zero. The behavior change IS the evidence.

DIRECT.definition: The human explicitly confirms the value: 'this saved me an hour,' 'this caught something I would have missed,' 'this is exactly what I needed.'
DIRECT.example: Shawn says 'good — that's 10 minutes I don't have to spend.' Direct, unambiguous.

INFERRED.definition: The system estimates value from proxies: time saved computed from timestamps, errors avoided from failure rates. No human confirmation, no behavioral change observed yet.
INFERRED.example: 'This proof ran 10 minutes faster, so ~10 minutes of human waiting saved' — reasonable but unconfirmed. Flagged as INFERRED until corroborated.

observation.independent_observer_rule: Value is observed by someone other than the seat that acted: the human director, an independent seat, or automated measurement against a pre-registered outcome plan. The acting seat's own assessment is input, never verdict.
observation.outcome_plan: For significant actions, the decision receipt SHOULD include an outcome plan: what human outcome is expected, how it will be observed, and when. The Value Engine later checks the plan against reality. Actions without outcome plans can still accrue value, but planned-then-verified outcomes score higher confidence.

time_horizon.decay_function: time_decay = 1 / (1 + days_to_realization / 30). Immediate outcomes count fully; a value realized 30 days out counts half; 90 days out counts quarter. The decay is a discount for uncertainty, not a statement that future value matters less — long-horizon value is tracked in a separate LEDGER so it is not forgotten, just honestly discounted in the moment.

horizons.IMMEDIATE: Outcome observable within the decision's own verification window (minutes to hours).
horizons.LONG: Weeks to months. Tracked in the long-horizon ledger with scheduled re-observation. Never scored on projection alone — only on realized observation.
horizons.SHORT: Days. The most common horizon for operational value.

time_horizon.long_horizon_ledger: A separate, persistent record of predicted long-term value with scheduled re-observation dates. When the date arrives, the Value Engine checks: did it materialize? Predictions that materialize raise the predictor's credibility; predictions that don't are recorded as misses. This is how the system learns to take long-term value seriously without pretending to measure what hasn't happened yet.

mission: Bind every NayaPOWER capability to verified human outcomes. Capability is the means; verified human value is the end. The Value Engine is the layer that keeps the entire organism pointed at humans, not at itself.
rationale: The Value Engine exists because of a single failure mode that kills intelligent systems: they get very good at getting better at things that don't matter. Compute efficiency, benchmark scores, decision throughput, architectural elegance — all of these can climb indefinitely while human outcomes flatline. The only defense is a layer whose entire job is to ask, continuously and rigorously: 'but did any human's life actually get better, and can we prove it?' The design answers the hardest questions first: capability vs value (the core distinction, made load-bearing in the scoring rule), attribution (multiplicative, humble, topped at 0.85), Goodhart (four independent defenses, because one is never enough), definition authority (the human director owns the ontology — value is not up for a vote among the optimizers), and ambiguity (recorded as uncertain, never forced into false precision). The integrations make the Value Engine the nervous system of the whole stack: NBA predicts, Value Engine measures, META learns, the Adversary gets audited, Dream gets graded. Nothing in the system is allowed to claim value without the Value Engine's independent verification — and the Value Engine itself is held to human ground truth every 30 days. That last loop is the most important one: the measurer is measured, by the humans it exists to serve.

contested_value.examples: One seat claims an action created value; another claims it destroyed value (e.g., automation that saves time but removes human oversight).
contested_value.rule: Contested value is NEVER averaged. Averaging disagreement produces a number that represents no one's judgment. The contest is recorded with both positions and their evidence, flagged CONTESTED, and escalated to the human director for adjudication. Until adjudicated, the outcome contributes 0 to V totals and is tracked separately.

ambiguity_protocol.rule: When value is ambiguous, the Value Engine records UNCERTAIN with the ambiguity named — never a false-precision number. UNKNOWN value ≠ zero value ≠ positive value. The three are tracked as distinct states.
ambiguity_protocol.uncertain_value: Recorded with: what is known, what is unknown, what would resolve it, and a re-observation date. Uncertain outcomes are revisited, not forgotten.

anti_gaming.rule_1: Value labels come from independent observation or human confirmation — never from the acting seat, never from META training on its own outputs.
anti_gaming.rule_2: The value ontology and category weights are set by the human director. Seats cannot redefine value to make their actions score higher.
anti_gaming.rule_3: Outcome diversity rule (40% cap) prevents single-metric optimization.
anti_gaming.rule_4: Any detected attempt to game value measurement (e.g., manufacturing attributable outcomes, pressuring human confirmation) is a governance incident — escalated immediately, not merely down-scored.

definition_authority.human_signals_are_input_not_definition: A user's expressed satisfaction ('thanks, that was helpful!') is evidence — it feeds the DIRECT evidence tier. But satisfaction is not the DEFINITION of value. A user can be satisfied by something with no lasting benefit, or dissatisfied by something that saved them from a costly mistake. The ontology defines what counts; signals provide evidence within it.
definition_authority.ontology_change_protocol: Changes to the value ontology (adding/removing categories, changing category weights) require: proposal with rationale, team review, Scorecard Law merge, and human director approval. The ontology is law, not configuration.
definition_authority.rule: The human director (Shawn) defines the value ontology: which categories of human outcome count as value, and their relative weights. The Value Engine measures WITHIN that ontology — it does not invent, extend, or reinterpret it. If the Value Engine encounters a human outcome that seems valuable but fits no category, it records it as UNCLASSIFIED_VALUE_CANDIDATE and proposes an ontology addition through the governance process. It never unilaterally expands the definition.
definition_authority.unclassified_value: Real human benefit that fits no current category is the most important signal the Value Engine can produce — it means the ontology is incomplete. Such findings are escalated prominently, not buried.

value_function.formula: V_outcome = magnitude × confidence × attribution × time_decay; V_total(window) = Σ V_outcome over all verified outcomes in the window; V_by_category tracked separately for the diversity rule.
value_function.formula_justification: Multiplicative, not additive, because each factor is a distinct way the claim can be wrong: a huge benefit with no evidence (confidence ~0) is worth ~0; a certain benefit with no causal link (attribution ~0) is worth ~0; a real benefit far in the future (decay) is worth less now. Addition would let a large magnitude compensate for zero evidence — the exact failure the evidence law forbids. Multiplication enforces: every link in the chain must hold.

magnitude.definition: How much did the human's state improve?
magnitude.examples: 0.1 = trivial convenience. 0.5 = meaningful time/effort saved or a real problem solved. 0.9 = prevented a serious failure, unlocked a blocked human goal, or transformed a workflow.
magnitude.scale: 0.0 (no improvement) to 1.0 (transformative improvement). Scored by the independent observer against the category's rubric, not by the acting seat.

prevented_harm.note: Prevented harm is the hardest value to measure and the easiest to inflate ('I prevented a disaster!'). It is therefore held to the highest standard: counterfactual estimates are always flagged ESTIMATE, confidence is capped at 0.5 without corroborating evidence, and repeated prevented-harm claims from the same seat trigger Adversary review for reward-hacking.
prevented_harm.rule: Prevented harm counts as value — a caught failure IS human value. But it is scored as: V = magnitude × min(confidence, 0.5) × attribution × time_decay, with the confidence cap lifted only by independent corroboration (e.g., the failure mode demonstrably occurred in a control case).

worked_example.action: Naya 2 auto-dispatched the commit proof after a main advance (2026-10-05).

outcome_record.attribution_basis: human_attribution — Shawn explicitly noted the saved clicks and avoided stale-SHA failure; behavioral corroboration (he stopped manual dispatching).
outcome_record.confidence_basis: DIRECT evidence tier — human confirmed the time saved and the avoided failure.
outcome_record.magnitude_basis: Meaningful but routine: ~10 minutes of human attention saved plus one avoided failure mode. Not transformative, genuinely useful.
outcome_record.observed_by: independent — human director confirmation + behavioral observation

worked_example.verdict: V = 0.513. Genuine verified human value. This is the kind of outcome the system should produce routinely — and the Value Engine's job is to make sure the system knows the difference between this and motion.

burden_reduced.definition: Human cognitive load, time, or attention freed for higher-value use.
examples: Proof results arriving before the decision point instead of after
Eliminated toil the human used to perform by hand

capability_enabled.definition: The HUMAN can now do something they could not do before. (Not system capability — human capability.)
examples: A non-technical user deploying through the Hub
A successor Naya solving a problem class it never saw

continuity_preserved.definition: Knowledge, context, or momentum carried across sessions, seats, or successors without loss the human would otherwise suffer.
examples: Cold successor picks up exactly where the prior seat left off
No repeated explanations demanded of the human

decision_improved.definition: A human made a better choice because of Naya's contribution — better informed, better timed, or better verified.
examples: Scorecard-backed recommendation the human accepted and that worked
Adversary flag that prevented a bad call

harm_prevented.definition: A failure, error, or loss the human would otherwise have suffered did not occur because of Naya's action.
examples: Bad proof promoted to production — blocked

trust_earned.definition: Verified reliability that changes human behavior: the human delegates more, checks less, and moves faster because proof exists.
examples: Team merges without re-reading every diff because receipts are trustworthy
trust_earned.note: Trust is value AND it is dangerous — misplaced trust is catastrophic. This category is scored only on verified reliability with evidence, never on claimed reliability.

value_ontology.category_weights_note: Weights sum to 1.0 and are set by the human director. They express the director's judgment about which kinds of human benefit matter most. decision_improved leads (0.25) because better human decisions compound; trust_earned is smallest (0.05) because trust must be earned slowly and is the easiest to fake.
value_ontology.definition: The closed set of human-outcome categories that count as value. An outcome that fits no category is not scored as value — it is recorded as UNCLASSIFIED_VALUE_CANDIDATE and proposed as an ontology addition.
